name: replace-doodad-overlap
description: bugs.md: Replace Doodads leaves a doodad whose new type's pathing would overlap another's. Input tests/fixtures/we-compare/make-replace-doodad-input.mjs (its head lists the seventeen cases). The editor's steps are replace-doodad-grid's: Replace Doodads barrel LTbs -> crates LTcr, every barrel, the two types chosen by the preferences the spec writes (see replace-doodad-grid; until branch we-compare-17 by Home and Down keys in the deDE lists, which the English editor's lists and the last run's tileset broke). Studio: w3.terrain.replaceDoodads {from LTbs, to LTcr}. MEASURED (2026-11-15, branch replace-doodads-overlap): crates on c1, c2 (a tree touching the edge), c6 (pathless LPcr), c14 (footman 40 out), c17 (across a cliff: the ground doesn't count), of two barrels whose crates would overlap the one first in the file (c9, c10: one by one, a crate made counts for the next), of c11 the eastern one (the western's crate would cover it); barrels stay beside a tree, crates, LOsh, a footman (8 and 24 out, 8 in), a farm and an item. Studio: replace.ts roomForReplaced, roomCells.

steps.eval: const s = await w3.services.get('w3.terrain'); const loaded = () => (s.placedObjects()?.doodads?.length ?? 0) > 0; for (let i = 0; i < 60 && !loaded(); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); if (!loaded()) throw new Error('the doodads were not loaded'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const n = await w3.commands.execute('w3.terrain.replaceDoodads', { from: 'LTbs', to: 'LTcr' }); if (!(n >= 1)) throw new Error('replaced ' + n); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); await w3.editors.saveAll();
